facts.fact: 当晚叙述者坐在 Denue 家院外一棵树上监视他家前门，并把 Crimson 带到靠后的安静处藏进一丛灌木后；Denue 家的木屋 nearly twice the size of my parents' home（几乎是叙述者父母家的两倍大），而这对父母养出了一个恶霸（raised a bully）。
facts.quote:
That night I sat perched in a tree beyond the


Denue  family’s  spacious  yard,  with  a  clear  view  of their  front  door.  I  had  led  Crimson  to  a  quiet  spot farther  back,  hidden  behind  a  cluster  of  bushes.  I could  see  his  position  as  well,  if  the  wolves  found him and caused him any trouble.


The  Denues  had  a  comfortable  cottage


nearly twice the size of my parents’ home, well-lit by the  low-hanging  moon.  I  couldn’t  help  feeling envious, that these people seemed to have so much more than my family ever did, and yet they raised a bully.

facts.fact: 偷听到 Jacque Denue 深夜归家：Madame Denue 质问他深夜跟谁出去，他答刚和 Porthos、Gobin 在外面；母亲骂那两人是 lowlife good-for-nothings，并质问他哪来的刀；Jacque 说 'Found it. Need some extra protection.'（捡的，需要点额外保护），母亲斥他 'Stole it, you mean!'（你是说偷的）。
facts.quote:
“Porthos and Gobin.”


“Those  lowlife  good-for-nothings!  We  give

“Found it. Need some extra protection.” She snorted. “Stole it, you mean!

facts.fact: 叙述者不再纠结 Denue 一家的是非：明确此行目标不是 Jacque，而是 Grenault（I had not come for Jacque. I had come for Grenault.）。
facts.quote: No matter. I had not come for Jacque. I had come for Grenault.

facts.fact: 四头 Lycanthru 爬过草坪扑向 Denue 家，其中巨大的那头显然是 Grenault（Four wolves, including a gigantic one that was clearly Grenault）；他们只等 Denue 全家入睡便动手，因为 Grenault 渴望得到 Madame Leóne 的地址（Grenault was hungry for Madame Leóne's address.）。
facts.quote:
Four  wolves,  including  a  gigantic  one  that


was  clearly  Grenault.  They  had  only  waited  long enough  to  ensure  the  family  had  gone  to  sleep. Grenault was hungry for Madame Leóne’s address.

facts.fact: 叙述者潜入屋内后用一支弩箭放倒第一头狼（dropped the first one with a single bolt），另外两头狼惊呼被放倒者的名字 'Tumier!'。
facts.quote:
Until  I  dropped  the  first  one  with  a  single


bolt.


Two  other  wolves  gasped. “Tumier!”  one


cried.

facts.fact: Grenault 以变形形态现身：每头 Lycanthru 变形会多高一英尺（gained an extra foot in height），而他身高 nearly eight feet tall（接近八英尺）、耳朵擦着天花板；他对 Helena 说 'So nice of you to come, Helena. I've missed holding your lovely throat.'（很高兴你来，Helena，我想念捏住你可爱喉咙的感觉）。
facts.quote:
I gasped at the sight of him. Every Lycanthru


gained  an  extra  foot  in  height  but  he  now  stood nearly eight feet tall. He was frightening enough as a man  and  as  a  black  wolf  on  all  fours.  Standing upright, his ears scraping the ceiling, fangs glinting in the candlelight, he had become a genuine monster.


“My,  my,”  he  said  softly.  “Quite  a  dramatic


entrance.  So  nice  of  you  to  come,  Helena. I’ve missed holding your lovely throat.”

facts.fact: Grenault 说他早知道叙述者会来（But I also knew you would come），并宣称 'I'll be Prime before daybreak.'（天亮前将成为 Prime）；他当面认出红骑士是 'a little blonde girl with a scarred face'（一个金发、脸上有疤的小女孩），叫她靠近好端详；叙述者想起 Papa 的告诫 'You cannot hesitate.'（不能犹豫），举弩瞄准他双眼之间开火（I fired），Grenault 闪身让弩箭钉中门楣（mantle）。
facts.quote:
Of  course.  But I  also  knew  you  would


come.”  He  stepped  closer,  flashing  his  grinning fangs. “I’ll be Prime before daybreak.”


I  swallowed,  once  more  picturing  him  race


up  the  cooper  shop  wall  at  me.  Once  more  feeling his  giant  fingers  close around  my  throat.  I  held  the crossbow steady. “Step back. Friendly warning.”


He  laughed.  “I  didn’t  know  the  Red  Rider


could be friendly. But then, I didn’t know she was a little  blonde  girl  with  a  scarred  face.  Come  closer, Red Rider. I want a good look at you.”


Papa’s  voice echoed  in my  mind. You  cannot


hesitate.


I  stepped  forward  and  aimed  between  his


eyes. “Be careful what you wish for.”


I fired.


He dodged, letting my bolt strike the mantle.

facts.fact: 群狼抓起桌子、肖像画和木托盘作盾，叙述者再射的三支弩箭全钉进遮挡物；Grenault 挥桌把她打向大门，弩带断裂、弩摔落在地；她侧滚拾弩、拉开窗闩跳出窗外，翻落到门廊外侧贴墙喘息，听见 Denue 夫妇从床上起身问是谁——'They would all be dead in seconds.'（几秒内他们全家都会丧命）。
facts.quote:
Then  he  grabbed  an  end  table  as  the  other  wolves grabbed  a  portrait  and  a  wooden  tray  to  defend themselves. I fired three more bolts, which sank into their protective shields. I stepped back, angling for a position  to  shoot  as  they  advanced.  Without warning,  Grenault  swung  his  table  at  me,  knocking me toward the front door. The crossbow fell to the side, tearing free of the damaged strap.


“Take  her  down!”  the  wolf  behind  the


portrait growled.


They charged forward as I gasped. I spun away from them, letting one wolf rush


past me as I rolled sideways to retrieve the crossbow. I  stood  and  threw  open  the  window  latch  there  as the  end  table  swung  at  me  again.  I  ducked  and  it struck  the  window,  throwing  open  the  shutters.  I rose  and  threw  myself  backward  through  the opening, tumbling onto the front porch and  rolling off its side, out of sight.


I  pressed  my  back  against  the  outer  wall  of


the house, breathing heavily, as I heard the Denues rise from their beds, asking who was there.


They would all be dead in seconds.
